shared: Inspected Round02 reference adaptation, static prototype. Values are chosen from upstream visual estimates, not recovered CSS. Frame owns outer inset16px; card owns inner padding16px. No added shadows/separators, no ellipsis. At320px and enlarged text wrap and grow, never shrink below14px/500. Use Noto Sans KR and shared tokens. Implement only the current element; neighboring elements and all enclosing surfaces are provided. Buttons are disabled prototype examples without opacity fading. Native search is editable but has no filtering/submit. Source behavior beyond the still frame is unknown. Product copy/full second card are declared fictional adaptations.
